channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Flour production slumps in the U.S., increases in Canada
item.description: U.S. flour production in 2025 was the lowest in 14 years.

item.title: World’s winter wheat crops look good for now
item.description: Winter wheat crops look good in the Black Sea and the U.S., although there is plenty of drought in the U.S. winter wheat region.

item.title: ICE Canada Weekly: Canola needs to back away from highs
item.description: Concerns about canola getting too expensive have crept into the Canadian oilseed’s recent rally on the Intercontinental Exchange.

item.title: China extends anti-dumping probe on Canadian canola; pledges fair ruling
item.description: China will make a fair and final ruling on Canadian Canola, the Chinese commerce ministry said on Thursday, adding that its anti-dumping probe into the oilseed has been extended to March 9.

item.title: Burger King-owner Restaurant Brands beats fourth-quarter sales estimates
item.description: Restaurant Brands reported fourth-quarter comparable sales above estimates on Thursday, helped by resilient traffic at its Burger King and Tim Hortons chains.

item.title: Global humanitarian aid slashed by one-third
item.description: Humanitarian aid around the world was cut by a third in 2025 and Canada is one of the culprits.

item.title: Future of Food conference underscores need for unity in agriculture sector
item.description: Canada’s agriculture sector must work together for success — that was the message of the day at the 2026 Future of Food Conference in Ottawa.

item.title: Farmers of North America hits roadblock in attempt to acquire AgraCity
item.description: FNA wants to buy the AgraCity assets by court monitor is not having it.

item.title: Canadian farm milk price changes to reflect growing protein demand
item.description: Protein demand is growing and that’s mean the provincial boards who set how Canadian dairy farmers are paid are changing how much protein is emphasized in milk pricing.

item.title: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada cuts a blow to Prairie agriculture
item.description: The recently-announced cuts to Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada’s research, facilities and staff will be a massive blow to Prairie agriculture for many years to come.
